checklist.action: read ROADMAP.md priority matrix and current/next milestones
read most recent 3 retro entries (retros.md or RETRO.md or .pipeline-log.md)
read project insights.md — note candidate-near-threshold entries (count >= 2)
read decisions.md / docs/adr/ — list active commitments
list active ADR files that constrain near-term decisions
check for failing test suite, doctor checks, or bench regressions (project-specific commands)
scan open GitHub issues — note any stale-PR or blocking signals
read user-feedback memory entries — note active scope/style constraints
write one-paragraph survey summary to state file output.summary
for each enabled brainstorm source, collect candidates (see SKILL.md § brainstorm sources)
confirm >= 6 total candidates before advancing (a brainstorm with fewer is a survey miss)
each candidate has: title, source, one-line description, est. effort
write candidates list to state file output.candidates
score each candidate against project user-visible-value tests if defined (e.g., master_control ADR-0001's three tests)
score each candidate against estimated effort and dependencies
tag each candidate: pass | borderline | fails-uvv | cleanup | pre-req
note pre-existing ADR commitments that constrain triage
write triaged list to state file output.triaged
group related candidates into 2-5 clusters (themes / coherent milestones)
each cluster has: theme, included candidates, total effort, signal/effort score
write clusters to state file output.clusters
construct >= 2 distinct paths from clusters
confirm paths differ in EITHER ordered milestones, scope, or risk profile (not just slow/fast variants of the same plan)
each path has: name, included clusters, total effort, signal/effort, risks, dependencies
if only one path is genuinely viable: record short_circuit_reason in state file and proceed
write paths to state file output.paths
pick one path as the recommended default
write reasoning to output.reasoning (>= 3 sentences, naming which active ADRs / constraints support or oppose it)
list active ADR commitments that support / oppose the recommendation
output RECOMMEND_READY
user confirms recommendation OR picks alternative path (in light mode, model may default-confirm if recommendation is unambiguous)
if chosen != recommended: capture user's reasoning briefly in output.user_reasoning_if_override
detect directional change (chosen path overrides an active ADR commitment) — set output.directional_change = true and flag for ADR draft
output DECIDE_DONE
update ROADMAP.md priority matrix with chosen path's milestones (add rows or update existing)
if directional_change: draft new ADR file under docs/adr/ — title, status=Proposed, context, decision, consequences
append to retros.md (or equivalent): forward-link from most recent arc retro to this strategy session
render markdown summary to docs/strategy-sessions/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md (alternatives + recommendation + decision)
kick off /pipeline-next for the first execution task in the chosen path
output CAPTURE_DONE
